field_text_formatted.value: Both post credentials to an endpoint rather than to Drupal's login form, and that form is where Drupal hangs the rest of logging in. TFA interposes there. So does a forced password change, a terms-of-service gate, and anything else that alters it. Skip the form and you skip all of that, and so does anyone else who has the password.
